topics.topic: Whether the note should use RefusedAnswer.refusal.code or the model should gain a direct code field
questions: Must the note refer to the RefusedAnswer's refusal.code field instead of the nonexistent RefusedAnswer.code field, or must the RefusedAnswer model gain a code field?
Must the note read the code through RefusedAnswer.refusal.code, or must RefusedAnswer gain a code field?
Must the note identify the code through the RefusedAnswer's refusal field, or must RefusedAnswer gain a code field?

quotes: _render_owner_page: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that the owner signs in from the page the owner interface first shows: submitting, as a browser does, the sign-in form of the page of a RefusedAnswer whose code is the UNAUTHENTICATED member of = models.RefusalCode, with the owner credential in the OwnerRequest's presented_credential field, through serve_owner_request answers the page of a SignedInAnswer, and with a wrong credential a refusal of the UNAUTHENTICATED member of = models.RefusalCode.
RefusedAnswer fields (exact, no others exist): answer_kind: Literal['refused'], refusal: Refusal
judgement.why: The note requires a code belonging directly to RefusedAnswer, while the exact model surface permits only answer_kind and refusal, so implementing that field access would violate the model contract; the note must instead identify the nested refusal.code field.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
